name: rgb2ycbcr
comment: MATLAB rgb2ycbcr — RGB->YCbCr (BT.601). DOUBLE-input path: studio swing scaled to [0,1]; pins Y/Cb/Cr at two pixels. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-9). NOTE: integer-class (uint8/uint16) input is a separate numkit gap (currently returns DOUBLE in [0,1] not same-class studio integers) — tracked in a dedicated fix task.
